lines.text: Text, Button and TextInput take any `fontSize` in pixels, and text is UTF-8. Without `font` they use the runtime's DejaVu Sans. A ZWJ sequence Twemoji has no image for draws as its first emoji, and a symbol such as `❤` without `U+FE0F` stays a font glyph. `.fnt` and `.bdf` fonts draw no emoji.

lines.text: - `host/plugin.ts` defines the commands with `defineHostPlugin(id, { name: command<Payload, Result>(guard) })`. Deck Apps import it, so it is bundled into them and must not import Node.js modules. The companion runs `guard` on every payload before your code.

lines.author: Máté Molnár

lines.text: - `host/companion.ts` default-exports `implementHostPlugin(plugin, { name: async (payload) => result })`. It runs in the companion with Node.js. `tsc` fails if a command is missing or returns the wrong type; throw `new HostCommandError("unsupported_platform", "...")` to answer with a specific code.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: fix(host-control): a broken plugin build keeps the last good package
lines.text: - `"hostPlugin": { "entry": "./host/companion.ts" }` in `vitadeck.config.json` makes `build` and `dev` also write `dist/my-app.vdplugin`, a **Host Plugin Package**, and its `dist/my-app.vdplugin.zip`. The package holds `manifest.json` and `companion.mjs`, your implementation bundled with its npm dependencies (pure JavaScript only). Add `"files": "./host/files"` to ship other files too, like scripts or data; read them with `new URL("./files/<name>", import.meta.url)` when a command runs, since a rebuild that changes only `files/` does not re-run your module. The `.vdplugin.zip` keeps no file permissions, so run a shipped script through its interpreter (`execFile("sh", [path])`) rather than directly.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(host-control): computers push events to Deck Apps by long-polling
lines.text: - To send events, declare them as a third argument, `defineHostPlugin("lights", { toggle: ... }, { changed: event<{ room: string; on: boolean }>() })`, and emit them from a lifecycle in `host/companion.ts`: `implementHostPlugin(lightsPlugin, { toggle: ... }, { start: (emit) => { const stop = watchLights((room, on) => emit("changed", { room, on })); return stop; } })`. `start` runs when the companion loads the plugin, and the function it returns runs when it unloads or reloads. `emit` only accepts the declared events and their data.

lines.author: Máté Molnár

The project's `package.json` exports `host/plugin.ts`, so a Deck App adds the project as a dependency (a local path such as `pnpm add ../lights`, a git URL, or npm once you remove `"private": true`) and imports the commands. lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(layout): Stack flows Text using measured size (#118)
lines.text: - `Text` flows in a `Stack` like any child, as wide as its widest line (or its `width`) and one `lineHeight` per line tall. In a `Rect`, each `Text` instead sits one line below its `y` for every `Text` before it.

lines.summary: feat(input): TextInput with Vita IME dialog and host keyboard editing (#86)
lines.text: `TextInput` is a controlled single-line field. Pressing it starts an edit: the Vita opens its keyboard dialog, pre-filled with `value` and titled with `placeholder`; the desktop build edits in place, where you type, Backspace deletes, Enter confirms and Escape cancels. `onChange` fires once with the final text when the edit is confirmed; a cancelled edit fires nothing.
